recentItems.title: ‘'Di Puwedeng Hindi Puwede!' FULL MOVIE TEASER | Robin Padilla, Vina Morales
recentItems.description:
Carding (Robin Padilla), an ex-convict, tries to lead a new life as a rent-a-car driver. Kristine (Vina Morales) tricks him into driving a get-away car for a hold-up operation. After being mistaken for a suspect, Carding is arrested by the police. Released in 1999 and directed by Francis ""Jun"" Posadas. 

Starring Robin Padilla, Vina Morales, and Bayani Agbayani.

recentItems.title: 'Tunay na Tunay: Gets Mo? Gets Ko!' FULL MOVIE TEASER | Jolina Magdangal, Robin Padilla
recentItems.description:
In this restored and remastered film, when undercover cop Nick's (Robin Padilla) cover is blown, he decides to work at a Chinese restaurant in an attempt to survive. There he strikes up a friendship with waitress Tin Tin (Jolina Magdangal), a girl running away from her past.' Released in 2000 and directed by Joyce Bernal. 

Starring Robin Padilla, Jolina Magdangal, Bearwin Meily, and Roldan Aquino.
